messages:
maya: Quick pass on blog draft — need final signoffs: Legal, SEO, and Product. Also confirm benchmark numbers and finalize webinar CTA/registration path. Plan: publish Tue 3/30 10am PT embargo.

ethan: uploading latest draft to GDrive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Example — filename: launch_blog_draft_v4.md

liz: quick editorial notes — tone is good, tighten intro + reduce passive voice. I'll push a few inline edits.

beth_product: thanks. Bench numbers: 1.5ms p50 on 8k tokens is from internal run on Dedicated tier; attaching table. Can we phrase as 'median latency' and include dataset name? Legal needs source link.

alex_seo: SEO notes — add H1, meta desc, and canonical. Suggested keywords: 'LLM inference platform', 'low latency inference', 'model serving cost'. Meta draft: "Deliver predictable, low-latency LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Also recommend adding schema.org Article markup and OG tags.

maya: @beth_product can you drop the latency table into the doc and add the exact test command? e.g. `runtest --model redwood/opt-7b --seq 8192 --mode batch` so legal/seo can verify.

beth_product: done, added table + command snippet in the Bench section. Also added a short blurb on canary rollout behavior and fallback to quantized variant.

liz: FYI I trimmed the hero claim to avoid superlatives. New hero: "High-performance LLM inference you can run anywhere." Please weigh in if product wants stronger language.

ethan: scheduling screenshots for Console and benchmark graph. Will export SVG + PNG fallback for email and social.

alex_seo: please add OG tags and ensure Twitter card image is 1200x630. Also request the blog slug be /blog/launch-inference-runtime for clarity.

maya: Legal: any red flags? @legal-team

ops-bot: legal-review Reminder — legal-team requested 24h for marketing claims review. Deadline: 5867970000 (unix).

beth_product: legal ok with phrasing after we cite the internal run and remove the word 'fastest'. I've updated the line and added the dataset citation.

maya: ok looks good. Next steps: final approval from @liz + @alex_seo by EOD tomorrow, set embargo 3/30 10am PT, create HubSpot form with tag 'launch_webinar' and routing to webinar list, and set webinar CTA button to /events/launch-webinar.

ethan: I'll handle HubSpot form + redirect and add UTM params: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch2026. Also adding hidden field utm_term=launch_inference.

liz: approved from editorial side.

alex_seo: SEO approved.

maya: thanks all — locking copy, portal handoffs on my list. I'll post final publish checklist here when done :party_parrot:
